description: This file contains utility functions for handling repository paths, parsing TypeScript source files to find import/export statements, comparing inventory entries, and performing inventory checks. It appears to be a library of helper functions for inventory management and module analysis within a project.

methods.name: normalizeRepoPath
methods.description: Converts an absolute file path into a repository-relative path with forward slashes.

methods.name: resolveRepoSpecifier
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier to a repository-relative path based on the repository root.

methods.name: visitModuleSpecifiers
methods.description: Traverses a TypeScript source file AST, calling a visitor on import, export, and dynamic import specifiers.

methods.name: diffInventoryEntries
methods.description: Compares expected and actual inventory entries, returning missing and unexpected entries.

methods.name: writeLine
methods.description: Writes a line of text to a given stream.

methods.name: collectTypeScriptInventory
methods.description: Reads multiple TypeScript files and collects inventory entries from them.

methods.name: runBaselineInventoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a baseline inventory check, comparing actual versus expected inventory, producing human-readable or JSON outputs, and indicating match/mismatch status.
